ev.q: is a 2008 platform video game created by independent developer Derek Yu
The player controls a spelunker who explores a series of caves while collecting treasure
The player can collect many items, mainly gold and jewels which add to the player's score
making each run-through of the game unique
Levels are randomly generated and grouped into four increasingly difficult
local multiplayer (co-op and deathmatch) for up to four players
criticizing some control quirks and throwaway multiplayer
